verdict.rationale: ROS 2 positions itself as a set of libraries and tools spanning 'drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms,' installable as Debian packages. Community users confirm a large ecosystem: many existing nodes and drivers, shared message packages that let libraries interoperate, Nav2 for navigation, and a UR arm controller. Caveats are that some sub-projects are abandoned or maintained only by ROS developers, and the supplied debs are called unsuitable for many product deployments. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a package registry/index and its discovery or dependency-resolution workflow, explicit evidence of pulling hardware driver packages during bring-up, and evidence on the maintenance quality of ecosystem packages.
